description: A device's calling endpoint, in the subscriber's own repo. Transcribed from connect docs/contract.md §1 (contract v2), which is canonical. Record key: one per device — `self` is the primary device (v1 compatible); additional devices use any stable slug (e.g. `phone`, `laptop`). A record with no endpointId is malformed (not "not listed").

homeRelay.description: relay URL hint; discovery-only if absent
